app_fee.value: International graduate application fee is $65 USD ($50 USD non-refundable for domestic graduate applicants).
app_fee.quote: Submit an online application to the graduate program and pay the accompanying $65 application fee.

also.quote: Domestic applicants will need to submit a $50 non-refundable application fee along with the application.

fee_waiver.value: CMU's published graduate application fee waiver applies to U.S. military veterans, active duty, National Guard, and Reserve service members; no general international graduate fee waiver is published.
fee_waiver.quote: All U.S. military veterans, active duty, National Guard and Reserve service members are eligible to have their application fee waived.

gre_general.value: GRE requirements are set by individual graduate programs (see program overrides): Mathematical Sciences and Statistics & Analytics require the general GRE, whereas BCMB, Neuroscience, and Science of Advanced Materials list GRE scores as optional.

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL score of 79 iBT (550 PBT) for regular admission (ETS institutional code 1106; Duolingo 100, PTE 53, MET 52 also accepted).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL: 550 PBT/79 IBT for regular admission.

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS score of 6.5 for regular admission.

english_waiver.value: Applicants from CMU's TOEFL Exempt Countries list (which excludes India) are exempt, and proficiency can also be satisfied by completing a degree program (such as a baccalaureate degree) or 24+ graded postsecondary credits (2.50 GPA) at a recognized institution where the language of instruction is English.
english_waiver.quote: Successful completion of a course of study (e.g. high school diploma, associate degree, baccalaureate degree) at a recognized institution where the language of instruction is English.

notes: 7 STEM Ph.D. programs offered: Biochemistry, Cell & Molecular Biology; Earth & Ecosystem Science; Mathematical Sciences; Neuroscience; Physics; Science of Advanced Materials; Statistics & Analytics. ETS institution code: 1106.
